assessment.comparison: Compares UNEP 2020 S-LCA / SO-LCA (with 2021 Methodological Sheets), EU Commission Recommendation (EU) 2021/2279 Annex III OEF (with OEFSR Guidance v6.3), PSILCA v3 (Eora 15,000 sectors / openLCA), SHDB (Benoît-Norris et al. 2012, 191 countries x 57 sectors & GTAP 6,441 CSS), UNEP GLAM V1.0.2024.10 Work Environment Impacts & Fantke et al. 2026 (with CML 2001 Part 3 & ILCD 2010), and Meemken et al. 2021 sustainability standards across seven analytical dimensions: (1) product functional unit vs organizational portfolio reference (OEF NACE 14 40,000 T-shirts + 20,000 trousers = 17,000 kg with single-garment weekly laundry slip vs SO-LCA ban on public comparative assertions and per-piece dilution of 1 union-busting event / 60,000 garments); (2) social satellite matrix linearity conditions and PSILCA openLCA pseudo-elementary-flow vs monetary diagonal post-normalization; (3) PSILCA Eq. 1 0.001–1 h/USD derivation, GLAM 2024 workbook 52-country uniform $43,746/W_c scaling (TUR/CHE = 28.76x, omitting IND/BGD/VNM) contradicting Fantke et al. 2026 §3.5.4, and fair-wage/price (2.0x) vs automation/craft (4.0x) paradoxes; (4) SHDB 0.1% worker-hour cutoff vs PSILCA monetary cutoffs (-43.96% & -76.96% child-labor drop), US OSHA global extrapolation, and Meemken et al. 5-level selection bias, 50%/79% uninspected cocoa farmers & 30%–70% uncertified sales; (5) Type II occupational health DALY pathways (~70,000,000 DALY, 0.72 DALY/injury, 33.3 vs 23.6 YLL/fatality, leisure physical-activity benefit non-extrapolation) vs irreducible fundamental labor rights; (6) SHDB linear 0/1/2/3 + step boost vs PSILCA geometric 10x scale 15.77x rank reversal on identical 100 h profiles; (7) three distinct meanings of zero (including PSILCA No data = 0.1 -> 9.0 med risk h on 90 h) and a four-cell E-LCA/S-LCA/LCC double-counting audit.
